006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyDefinition;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IDefinition;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IFieldDefinition;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IFlagDefinition;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
015
016import java.util.List;
017import java.util.Locale;
018import java.util.function.Supplier;
019
020import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
021
022/**
023 * Provides an base implementation for a set of constraints that target a
024 * definition using a target Metapath expression.
025 *
026 * @param <T>
027 *          the Java type of the constraint container
028 */
029public abstract class AbstractTargetedConstraints<T extends IValueConstrained>
030    implements ITargetedConstraints, IFeatureValueConstrained {
031  @NonNull
032  private final ISource source;
033  @NonNull
034  private final Supplier<List<IMetapathExpression>> targets;
035  @NonNull
036  private final T constraints;
037
038  /**
039   * Construct a new set of targeted constraints.
040   *
041   * @param source
042   *          information about the resource the constraints were sources from
043   * @param targets
044   *          a supplier to get the Metapath expressions that can be used to find
045   *          matching targets
046   * @param constraints
047   *          the constraints to apply to matching targets
048   */
049  protected AbstractTargetedConstraints(
050      @NonNull ISource source,
051      @NonNull Supplier<List<IMetapathExpression>> targets,
052      @NonNull T constraints) {
053    this.source = source;
054    this.targets = targets;
055    this.constraints = constraints;
056  }
057
058  @Override
059  public ISource getSource() {
060    return source;
061  }
062
063  @Override
064  public List<IMetapathExpression> getTargets() {
065    return ObjectUtils.notNull(targets.get());
066  }
067
068  @Override
069  public T getConstraintSupport() {
070    return constraints;
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Apply the constraints to the provided {@code definition}.
075   * <p>
076   * This will be called when a definition is found that matches the target
077   * expression.
078   *
079   * @param definition
080   *          the definition to apply the constraints to.
081   */
082  protected void applyTo(@NonNull IValueConstrained definition) {
083    getLetExpressions().values().forEach(definition::addLetExpression);
084    getAllowedValuesConstraints().forEach(definition::addConstraint);
085    getMatchesConstraints().forEach(definition::addConstraint);
086    getIndexHasKeyConstraints().forEach(definition::addConstraint);
087    getExpectConstraints().forEach(definition::addConstraint);
088  }
089
090  @Override
091  public void target(IFlagDefinition definition) {
092    applyTo(definition);
093  }
094
095  @Override
096  public void target(IFieldDefinition definition) {
097    applyTo(definition);
098  }
099
100  @Override
101  public void target(IAssemblyDefinition definition) {
102    applyTo(definition);
103  }
104
105  /**
106   * Throws a {@link ConstraintInitializationException} indicating that the
107   * constraint target is not valid.
108   *
109   * @param definition
110   *          the targeted definition
111   * @throws ConstraintInitializationException
112   *           when method is called to indicate that the provided definition is
113   *           not a valid constraint target
114   */
115  protected void wrongDefinitionTypeTargeted(@NonNull IDefinition definition) {
116    throw new ConstraintInitializationException(
117        String.format(
118            "The %s named '%s' from metaschema '%s' is incorrectly targeted by a set of" +
119                " constraints with the target(s) '%s'. Ensure the target expression is correct in '%s'.",
120            definition.getModelType().name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT),
121            definition.getEffectiveName(),
122            definition.getContainingModule().getQName().toString(),
123            getTargets(),
124            getSource().getLocationHint()));
125  }
126}
